newsitem.title: USA: CSCE world sugar ends lower, prices drift in range.
newsitem.headline: CSCE world sugar ends lower, prices drift in range.

text.p: CSCE world sugar futures settled a thinly-traded session weaker, with activity stymied by a dearth of physical news, a balanced technical picture and a golf outing which took several players out of the ring, market sources said.
Volume was estimated at a mere 6,095 lots.

While March climbed to resistance seen in the mid-10.90 cent a lb range, the contract was unable to hold gains and fell to its low. Prices did not stray from their current trading range, however, with support seen at 10.75 and then at 10.60.
Floor sources noted speculative stops above 11.00 in March.
The March contract eased 0.05 on the day to close at 10.88, having ranged from 10.94 to 10.83. The back months settled 0.04 lower to 0.01 firmer.
Open interest in the March contract fell 843 lots to 84,802 lots.
